refund-request.v2: Thanks for reaching out about a refund. You can get a full refund within 14 days of delivery; after that we can offer store credit. Just reply with your order number and we will take care of it.
refund-request.why: the macro still says 30 days; policy v3 cut the window to 14 days

password-reset.fixed: We just emailed you a password reset link. The link expires after 24 hours, so please use it today; if it expires, reply here and we will send a new one.
password-reset.why: the link cannot both expire after 24 hours and never expire

call-me-back.why: the extended phone hours were approved on 2026-10-06 and go live with policy v4; the macro is right, the policy document is behind

damaged-item.v2: Sorry your item arrived damaged! We will send a free replacement right away. Trailhead Plus members can choose a full refund instead and keep the item.
damaged-item.why: the macro states "replace rather than refund" as a rule for everyone; the policy lets Trailhead Plus members choose a refund

shipping-cost.v2: Standard shipping is free on orders over 50 dollars; smaller orders pay a flat 6 dollar shipping fee.
shipping-cost.why: policy v4 lowers the free-shipping threshold from 75 to 50 dollars
